newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein steady, CPO tender done.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein steady, CPO tender done.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were steady in late trading on Thursday helped by healthy gains in Malaysia, traders said.
They said olein was quoted at 1,415-20 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, up from 1,410-15 rupiah at the opening. Crude palm oil was done at 1,215 rupiah/kg at a tender in Medan.
"The increase in Malaysia is helping prices here," one trader said. "Some sellers are holding back hoping local prices will continue to improve tomorrow."
Traders said the gains in Malaysia could be due to an expected bullish crop report due to be released on Friday.
They said data to be released by Malaysian crop forecaster Ivan Wong was expected to be supportive.
Data from Belawan Port showed that the MT Haiyin Ocean will leave the North Sumatran port on Friday with 2,600 tonnes of crude palm oil for Port Klang, Malaysia.
The MT Sappire will leave also on Friday for Surabaya with 1,600 tonnes of olein.
